relationshipToReleasedHistoricalArtifact: This ranked 90-day operator source supplements the released one-experiment historical public artifact at sites/video-moment-search/product-experiment-ledger.json; it does not replace or alter that artifact.
noDataBoundary: No measured users, creator onboarding, referrals, usability, demand, revenue, task-completion, or paid-pilot evidence exists. Missing data is unknown or blocked, never zero demand.

personas.description: An applied-AI researcher enters a concept, receives a ranked list, and reaches the correct exact moment within 60 seconds. This is a heuristic preview gate, not usability or demand evidence.
A creator submits a rights-cleared library, inspects, corrects, or removes moments, and sees attributable referral evidence. No production creator submission or approved measurement exists.

An L&D lead searches an approved library, inspects adjacent context, saves or shares a timestamped list, and verifies permissions. Those adjacent-context, save/share, and permissions flows are not yet testable.

experiments.hypothesis: A bounded rights-review flow can admit authorized creator libraries without weakening source authority.
experiments.baseline: No data; creator authorization is unknown and blocked pending approved review.
experiments.stopRule: Stop authorization if source identity or authority, covered URLs/content, rights, commercial/excerpt/expiry/revocation terms, or caption provenance is ambiguous; quarantine the record.

experiments.hypothesis: Authorized additions can grow the corpus while correction and provenance controls remain reviewable.
experiments.baseline: No data; verified corpus growth is unknown and blocked pending authorized evidence.
experiments.stopRule: Stop admission when a moment lacks rights evidence, exact timestamp routing, or a correction/removal review path.

experiments.hypothesis: The search preview can route a researcher to the correct exact moment with a bounded heuristic gate.
experiments.baseline: No measured users; the released fixed flow is only a heuristic regression.
experiments.stopRule: Stop the preview gate if fewer than 80% of reviewed heuristic cases place the expected moment in the top three, any timestamp landing error occurs, or a zero-result case lacks an explicit review record.

experiments.hypothesis: Successful searches can make an exact-moment link useful enough to warrant a bounded measured test once measurement is approved.
experiments.baseline: No data; no approved measurement endpoint exists.
experiments.target: >=30% exact-moment click rate among successful searches.
experiments.stopRule: Stop after approved measurement if the rate remains below 30% among successful searches or any timestamp landing error is observed; do not infer task completion from clicks.

experiments.hypothesis: A bounded observation window can characterize non-branded impressions without claiming demand.
experiments.baseline: No data; non-branded discovery is unknown and blocked without approved measurement.
experiments.target: Provisional bounded observation target: 100 non-branded impressions in 90 days after approved measurement.
experiments.stopRule: Stop the observation if attribution is unavailable, source or query data would be retained, or 100 impressions are not observed by day 90; report unknown rather than zero demand.

experiments.hypothesis: A narrowly described pilot offer can be observed without representing offer clicks as revenue or demand proof.
experiments.baseline: No data; offer interest is unknown and blocked without approved measurement.
experiments.target: Provisional bounded observation target: 10 offer clicks in 90 days after approved measurement.
experiments.stopRule: Stop the observation if measurement is not approved, attribution would require personal or cross-site identifiers, or fewer than 10 offer clicks are observed by day 90; report no conclusion about demand.

experiments.hypothesis: A rights-safe operator workflow may earn one bounded paid-pilot signal without treating it as established revenue.
experiments.baseline: No data; paid-pilot evidence is unknown and blocked.
experiments.target: One paid pilot or credible signed paid commitment within 90 days.
experiments.stopRule: Stop the pilot path at day 90 without one paid pilot or credible signed paid commitment, or immediately if permissions, pricing authority, or evidence provenance is unresolved.
